notes: Seven concerns in scope (C3, C4, C7, C8, C10, C11, C12); none fixed in v1 (referees reviewed the v1 text). Both reviews raise the key reproducibility concern C7 and the step-attribution concern C10. B also raises the 1-10 Hz bandwidth (C11); A does not. C3 (field misalignment cross-coupling) and C4 (constancy of g0/flux responsivity across Bip) are partly matched by both only through requests to plot fitted ϕoff and Ic versus Bip, motivated by trapped flux rather than misalignment; these are generous partlys. Neither review suggests coherently driving the resonator (C12). A's partly on C8 rests on its question about a shared 22.5 mT step across cooldowns. Both reviews independently flag the 20.0 mT step as a possible stitching artifact and TLS frequency jumps, which match no referee concern. B adds many substantive physics critiques (vortex existence for d ~ ξ, Labusch coupling mechanism, ρeff factor of 3) absent from referees and from A.
